document.title: APEX Revenue OS
document.subtitle: AI-Native Revenue Operating System for Dubai Real Estate Teams

executive_summary.vision: Build the most intelligent WhatsApp-native revenue operating system for Dubai real estate teams.
executive_summary.product_promise: Every lead, message, viewing, follow-up, document, and deal is captured in one intelligent workspace that updates itself and recommends the next best action.
executive_summary.positioning: APEX is not a generic CRM. It is an AI-assisted revenue operating system designed around real estate workflows, customer conversations, property matching, controlled automation, and management visibility.
executive_summary.primary_outcome: Increase lead response speed, reduce lost follow-ups, improve buyer-property matching, improve deal visibility, and reduce manual CRM administration.
executive_summary.mvp_strategy: Launch a focused real estate product first. Treat creator economy, fintech, crypto, agent marketplace, and unrestricted app generation as future platform extensions.

problem_statement.core_problem: Real estate teams lose revenue because leads, messages, viewing details, documents, property preferences, and follow-ups are fragmented across WhatsApp, email, spreadsheets, portals, and individual agents.
pain_points: Leads are not consistently entered into the CRM.
WhatsApp conversations are disconnected from contact and deal records.
Agents forget follow-ups or update records too late.
Managers cannot see accurate pipeline health.
Buyer requirements are stored as unstructured notes.
Property matching is manual and inconsistent.
Viewing outcomes are not captured systematically.
Commission calculations are handled in spreadsheets.
Documents are scattered across email, cloud storage, and messaging apps.
Existing CRMs require excessive manual data entry.
AI features generate text but do not reliably execute operational workflows.

business_goals: Acquire the first 5 pilot brokerages in the UAE.
Achieve weekly active usage above 70 percent among onboarded agents.
Reduce median first-response time by at least 40 percent.
Reduce overdue follow-ups by at least 50 percent.
Increase qualified viewing bookings per active agent.
Create a repeatable onboarding process that can complete within 5 business days.
product_goals: Create a complete customer timeline across WhatsApp, email, calls, notes, tasks, viewings, offers, and files.
Automatically extract buyer requirements and update structured fields.
Provide next-best-action recommendations with human approval controls.
Match buyers to available properties using deterministic and AI-assisted ranking.
Provide managers with trustworthy pipeline, activity, response, and forecast dashboards.
Support real estate deal stages from initial inquiry to handover.
Maintain complete auditability for AI and user actions.
non_goals_mvp: TikTok, LinkedIn, and Discord inbox ingestion.
AI-only interface with no traditional screens.

product_principles: Every automated action must be explainable and auditable.
Stable operational screens with an AI command layer.
Real estate terminology and workflows by default.
Multi-tenant security from the first release.
Official APIs only for communication channels.
Progressive autonomy based on organization policy.

success_metrics.north_star_metric: Qualified opportunities actively progressed per advisor per month.
revenue_metrics: Gross margin after communication and AI costs
quality_metrics: Message synchronization success rate above 99 percent
AI extraction precision above 90 percent for required buyer fields
Audit log coverage at 100 percent for sensitive actions

requirements: Users can sign in with email and password.
Organizations are isolated tenants.
Users may belong to multiple organizations.
Organization context is required for all business data operations.
MFA must be available for owners and administrators.
Sessions must support secure revocation.
Invitations expire and can be revoked.
acceptance_criteria: A user cannot access records from an organization where they have no membership.
Switching organizations updates all visible data and permissions.
All tenant-sensitive queries are protected server-side.
Owners can revoke active sessions for organization members.

requirements: Permissions are enforced at API and database layers.
Managers can be restricted to assigned teams.
Advisors can be restricted to assigned records.
Sensitive financial and document permissions are separately configurable.
Custom roles can be created after MVP phase 1.

Link contacts to companies and households.
Identify buyer, seller, landlord, tenant, investor, partner, and referral relationships.
Detect likely duplicates using phone, email, normalized name, and external channel identifiers.
Display a complete relationship timeline.
Support custom fields using an approved field-definition system.
Create leads automatically from connected sources.
Apply assignment rules by team, language, location, property, source, workload, and round robin.
Detect and merge duplicate inquiries.
Start response-time SLA timers.
Notify the assigned advisor and manager.

Display messages in a single conversation timeline per contact.
Support assignment, status, priority, tags, internal notes, and mentions.
Link conversations to contacts, deals, properties, and viewings.
Support approved templates where required by channel policy.
Track delivery, read, failure, and response status when available.
Store provider message identifiers for deduplication.
Allow AI drafting but require policy-based approval.
Support Kanban, list, and table views.
Allow stage movement with validation rules.
Track stage history and time in stage.
Associate contacts, properties, conversations, tasks, viewings, offers, documents, and commissions.
Calculate weighted forecast using configurable probability.
Require loss reasons when deals are closed lost.
Trigger automations on stage changes.
Create and import property inventory.
Support sale and rental listings.
Store project, developer, community, building, unit, property type, bedrooms, bathrooms, size, price, status, furnishing, completion status, and availability.
Store media, brochures, floor plans, location, and portal links.
Track listing ownership, source, exclusivity, and expiry.
Maintain price and status history.
Support internal, private, draft, and published visibility.

Explain why each property matched.

Assign advisor and attendees.

Record outcome, feedback, objections, interest score, and next step.
Update related deal stage based on configured rules.

Create offers linked to deals and properties.
Track offer amount, deposit, conditions, expiry, status, counteroffers, and approval.
Track MOU, SPA, NOC, mortgage, payment, and handover milestones.
Provide configurable checklists by transaction type.
Alert users to overdue transaction milestones.
Upload, categorize, preview, download, version, and archive documents.
Link files to contacts, deals, properties, offers, and viewings.

example_commands: Show all buyers with budgets above AED 5 million who have not been contacted in three days.
Which deals are at risk this month and why?
Draft a WhatsApp follow-up for buyers who completed a viewing but gave no response.
Find three available two-bedroom properties in Downtown Dubai under AED 3 million.
Create tasks for all overdue viewing follow-ups, but show me the list before saving.

requirements: Workflows use versioned definitions.
Every execution is logged.
Actions are idempotent.
Failed runs support retries and dead-letter handling.
Organizations can configure approval requirements.
Bulk workflow activation requires administrator approval.
Provide secure token-based or authenticated access.
Allow buyers to review shortlists, confirm viewings, comment, and upload documents.
Allow sellers and landlords to view listing activity, inquiries, viewings, offers, and reports.
Brand portals per organization.
Log every external user action.
Allow portal access to be revoked immediately.
Log authentication, access, record mutation, export, integration, workflow, AI, financial, permission, and document events.
Audit records are immutable to organization users.
Each log includes actor, organization, action, target, timestamp, IP where available, request identifier, and before-after metadata.
Sensitive values must be redacted.
Audit logs must be searchable and exportable by authorized users.

autonomy_levels.name: disabled
autonomy_levels.description: AI does not process or act on the selected feature.

autonomy_levels.name: observe
autonomy_levels.description: AI analyzes data but does not create recommendations.

autonomy_levels.name: recommend
autonomy_levels.description: AI proposes actions and explains them.

autonomy_levels.name: draft
autonomy_levels.description: AI creates drafts or pending actions requiring approval.

autonomy_levels.name: policy_execute
autonomy_levels.description: AI executes pre-approved low-risk actions inside organization policy.

mandatory_human_approval: Workflow activation affecting more than 100 records

model_routing.strategy: Route tasks by sensitivity, latency, quality, and cost.

data_model.extension_strategy: Relational core with JSONB metadata and typed custom-field definitions.

api_specification.style: REST for product APIs, webhooks for external events, asynchronous jobs for long-running work.
api_specification.authentication: Secure session cookies for web clients and scoped API tokens for integrations.
api_requirements: All mutation endpoints require idempotency keys where duplicates would be harmful.
Every request receives a request identifier.
Validation errors use a consistent machine-readable format.
Rate limits apply per user, organization, token, and integration.
Webhook events must be stored before processing.
Failed webhook processing must be retryable.

mvp.name: WhatsApp Business Platform
mvp.purpose: Message synchronization, templates, delivery events, and customer communication.

mvp.name: Cloud object storage
mvp.purpose: Private document and property media storage.

frontend.framework: Next.js current stable App Router release
frontend.ui: Tailwind CSS and accessible component primitives
frontend.state_strategy: Server-first data loading with client state only where required
frontend.real_time: WebSocket or managed realtime channel for inbox and notifications

backend.primary_api: FastAPI or Next.js server architecture selected during technical spike
backend.language: Python for AI and data services; TypeScript permitted for product APIs

data.cache: Redis only when justified by workload

ai.primary_strategy: Use external models through a provider abstraction with optional Ollama fallback.
ai.observability: Prompt, response, latency, token, cost, confidence, and action logging

infrastructure.deployment: Managed cloud or hardened VPS architecture
infrastructure.monitoring: Application errors, logs, traces, uptime, queue health, integration health

standards_and_laws: Call recording consent requirements where applicable
security_requirements: Encryption in transit and at rest.
Daily backups and tested restore procedures.
Audit logging for all sensitive operations.

data_residency.requirement: Select hosting region and subprocessors based on customer contracts and UAE data requirements.

performance: Primary application pages should reach usable state within 2.5 seconds under normal broadband conditions.
Search responses should return within 1 second for standard filtered queries.
Inbox updates should appear within 3 seconds of provider webhook receipt.
Standard API requests should maintain p95 latency below 500 milliseconds excluding third-party dependencies.
Long-running AI or import jobs must be asynchronous.
availability: MVP target availability of 99.9 percent excluding scheduled maintenance.
Graceful degradation when AI providers are unavailable.
Queued recovery for temporary integration failures.
scalability: Support at least 100 organizations, 5,000 users, 5 million messages, and 1 million contacts without redesign.
Partition or archive high-volume message and audit data when thresholds require it.
accessibility: Target WCAG 2.2 AA for core workflows.
Clear focus states and semantic labeling.
localization: Architecture must support Arabic and right-to-left interfaces.
Store all timestamps in UTC and display in organization timezone.

ux_requirements.design_direction: Premium, high-trust, operational, fast, and calm. Avoid decorative complexity that slows daily work.
core_patterns: Table, Kanban, calendar, and timeline views
Record side panel for fast editing
Clear AI source and confidence indicators
Approval queue for pending AI actions

operational_dashboards: AI latency, cost, and failure rate

deliverables: Validated workflows with 3 to 5 UAE brokerages

risks.risk: WhatsApp platform restrictions or onboarding delays
risks.mitigation: Use official APIs, build provider abstraction, provide email fallback, and begin business verification during discovery.
Provide import validation, duplicate detection, normalization, and guided data cleanup.

risks.risk: AI hallucinations or incorrect field extraction
risks.mitigation: Use structured outputs, confidence thresholds, evidence display, approval controls, and evaluation datasets.
Default to draft mode, restrict autonomous actions, use organization policies, and log every action.
Lock MVP non-goals and require product approval for new P0 requirements.

risks.risk: Third-party property portal access is unavailable
risks.mitigation: Support CSV, email parsing, web forms, and public APIs where officially available.

risks.risk: Communication and AI usage costs exceed pricing
risks.mitigation: Meter usage, enforce budgets, route models by task, and separate pass-through communication charges.

pricing_hypothesis.principle: Charge a platform subscription plus included usage. Do not promise unlimited expensive communication or AI processing.

product: At least one official communication integration working in production.
AI drafting and field extraction include approval and evidence.
security: Incident response contacts and procedure documented.
